Our values

Our values drive everything we do at AssemblyAI

When you choose your workplace, you’re deciding on a lot more than just your job. You’re choosing a lifestyle. We’ve worked hard to shape a culture we’re proud to support.

trophy

Play to win

We're here to build a market-leading, top 1% company. While we know it doesn't happen overnight, we hold ourselves and our peers to this bar, and we seek to get better every day as we continue to build a winning product and service for our customers.

format_paint

Deliver with craftsmanship

We strive to be excellent in everything that we do: the emails we write, the products we create, the artifacts we produce – everything. While we do operate with urgency and move quickly, we're also proud of what we put out in the world, deeply care about the quality of our work, and sweat the details.

model_training

Be deeply curious

We are truth-seeking, always ready to dive into the raw materials at all levels, and are not afraid to ask the tough questions as we scratch a layer deeper in our search for clarity and to reduce ambiguity.

scale

Operate with integrity

We have high expectations, but we also care deeply about each other and our customers. We strive to always assume good intentions, ask questions versus make assumptions, treat others with respect, be deeply thoughtful in our actions, and lift each other up.

nest_clock_farsight_analog

Think long term

We are not afraid to quickly experiment, iterate, and learn as we pursue our long-term goals – but we do so intentionally and are not reactive. We aim to make thoughtful, long-term decisions over convenient ones. We operate with conviction and with resilience, and we embrace the ever-dynamic process of building a new company, especially in a new, evolving industry.

groups

Solve for company first

We're all on the same team – AssemblyAI. Regardless of the department or team we work in, we recognize that as a startup, individual and team success comes as a byproduct of AssemblyAI's success. We are collaborative with our colleagues, transparent with our work, and always strive to do what's best for AssemblyAI over ourselves or our team.

play_arrow Play
Benefits

We provide equitable, best-in-class rewards for our global team

A lot can happen throughout your career. We make sure you’re able to weather it all with comprehensive benefits.

globe_location_pin

Global remote team

We hire the best person for the job, regardless of location. Our remote-first culture allows team members to make an impact from anywhere in the world! Our team members span 16 countries.

And for those who do want to work in person, we have offices in New York, and San Francisco.

payments

Competitive salary

We invest in our people first and offer competitive salaries across all roles and locations.

star

Equity

We want our team members to have skin in the game and an opportunity to see long-term returns on the hard work they are putting in. To that end, every team member receives a generous equity grant.

heart_check

Premium benefit offerings

We offer premium medical, dental, and vision plans and cover up to 100% of the premiums for both the employee and their family. We also offer opportunities to contribute to an HSA or FSA, short-term and long-term disability coverage, and life insurance.

groups

Team offsites

We have regular team, and company-wide retreats in amazing locations to give everyone an opportunity to meet in person, collaborate, and build working relationships that make us a better team.

sunny

Flexible PTO

We offer an uncapped PTO policy to all team members and encourage everyone to take time off to recharge, do something fun, and spend time with loved ones.

payment_arrow_down

401k match

We're committed to supporting our team members long term and offer up to 4% 401k match to all US-based employees.

computer

Home office stipend

Every new team member gets $1,000 to improve their home office. We want to make sure everyone has the setup to do their best work.
